title: An acceptance pack's manifest: acceptance/<NN>/manifest.json
description: The stages of one phase's acceptance run, in the order the host runs them, and the steps of the phase's acceptance script with who does each. acceptance/README.md says it in plain words; acceptance/acceptance.test.mjs holds every pack to this schema and to the rules a schema cannot say. The host wrapper in bb2dash-stack reads the same shape (scripts/lib/accept-manifest.mjs) and refuses a field it does not know.
$comment: Only the keywords acceptance/schema-lite.mjs checks are used here: type, const, enum, pattern, minLength, maxLength, minimum, maximum, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, maxItems, oneOf and $ref to #/$defs.

base_url.description: The site under test: https, a host and nothing after it.

phase.description: The phase, as its folder is named: acceptance/21/.

stepId.description: A step of the acceptance script: its number, a letter when one step is two tests (14a), a suffix when half of it is done another way (2-desktop). Never `host`: that name is the host's own, for what it saves.

testTitle.description: A test's exact title in web/e2e/accept<NN>.spec.ts. It starts with its step's id.

evidenceFile.description: A file the step's test writes into the stage's output folder, by bare name.

proofName.description: A proof of this pack's proofs.json.

actionName.description: A host action. The list is bb2dash-stack's (scripts/lib/accept-actions.mjs): a pack can name one, never supply a command.

carried.description: A value the run read earlier: carry:<step>.<field> for an id or a time in that step's facts file, carry:host.<name> for what a host action saved.

value.description: A literal, or a carried value (see `carried`).

step.description: The host step this action proves, when it proves one.

oneOf.description: The host fetches the pinned commit into a throwaway volume and installs the browser-test dependencies.
The host runs these actions itself, in this order, and stops at the first that does not pass.
A fresh sandbox container in which the Claude operator runs these tests, one at a time, in this order. Afterwards the host reads each step's proofs itself.

deadline.description: The stage has a time limit: so many seconds after a time the run already has. The host hands it to the tests as ACCEPT_DEADLINE.

oneOf.description: A person does it. The run says so in its record and does not check it.
Not run, and the text says why, and names what stands in its place when something does.
The operator runs one browser test in a sandbox stage and judges what it shows; the host then reads each listed proof itself. Green needs both.
The host does it alone. The step is a label and a sentence: the actions of its stage that carry the label are what proves it.
